title: sarcochilus subulatus
intro: Sarcochilus subulatus, commonly known as the 'Forked Dendrobium', is a type of orchid that belongs to the family Orchidaceae. This plant has been used in traditional medicine to treat various health issues, including inflammation, fever, and respiratory problems, due to its numerous health benefits. The therapeutic actions of Sarcochilus subulatus include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which help to soothe and protect the body from harm. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
